derivation: Every substrate automorphism permutes the three distinct positive axis objects.
Every permutation of the three axes sends the three unordered two-axis sectors to the same three-sector atlas.
Shared-axis identity, component typing, finite path order, and the component-preserving commutation relation are preserved under the induced relabeling.
No N0 predicate in the allowed sources distinguishes a reflection from a cyclic relabeling; cyclic transport therefore proves a 3-cycle exists but does not reduce the full automorphism set to C3.
automorphism_classification.forbidden_shortcut: No orientation predicate was added to exclude odd permutations.
